text: Good evening. I am writing on behalf of my younger sister, Tolu, she is 10 years old. Her temperature is 39.9°C, we checked it just now. She has been having catarrh and sneezing since yesterday, and a small small cough, not serious. There is no rash on her body at all, I checked her well well. Her skin and lips are looking normal, the same colour as always. There is one bruise on her shin but she fell at the playground on Saturday and she told us herself, so it is from that one. Our mummy said I should send message to ask what we should do about the fever.
